modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Interpret information from various views, projection, 2D and 3D shapes

pcs.pc_description: interpret engineering drawing's uniqueness, dimensions and important features in 2D and 3D shapes

identify details of the machine component which are not clearly visible by interpreting section views
interpret Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerencing (GD&T) symbols in the drawings

read and interpret information from Tolerance Zone boundaries for part features in terms of shape and size
observe any modification, changes required in the drawing and communicate the same to the concerned team in the organization
store the drawings in an easily accessible place, avoiding damage from moisture, chemicals and fire

pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done by interpreting the assembly drawing/work instructions/SOPs
identify and arrange the tools, measuring instruments, equipment, auto components/parts and sub-assemblies as per the SOP and job requirements
select the appropriate assembling method and required tools and equipments in coordination with Electric Vehicle assembly technician
check the assembling tools, accessories, measuirng instruments and equipment for any defects and clean dust and impurities from them before use
check the terminals of battery and clean them by oxidants
support in filling CLRI (clean, lubricate, retighten & inspection) check sheet and report to the supervisor about any abnormalities identified and action taken to resolve them
lift the auto component manually or by hoist and place the same securely on the designated slot/space as indicated in the drawing/work instructions
follow safety practices during assembly process as per organisational SOP
support in setting of the equipment as per the selected assembly method
support in selecting the right programme in case of robotic assembly method as defined in the SOP

assist in assembly operations and assemble the safety parts i.e. bearings, shafts etc., battery systems, motors, electrical parts such as electric wire harness, Electronic Control Unit (ECU), automatic lock system, fuel injection system and other similar parts

assist in installation of the Oil and Lube systems by placing and fitting the funnel, filters, hose pipes, glands, sockets, suction guns and regulator valves as prescribed in the Work Instructions/ SOPs/Control Plans
support in adjusting, aligning and setting (gap and flushness) the parts, assemblies and aggregates by following Product Quality Standard (PQS)
carry out sealing of the required areas to prevent any leakage of water/air etc. during the usage of the component
support in numbering of the wires connected to batteries during the assembly process
carry out labeling on the auto components like High voltage sticker indication etc. specifying the information related to assembly process and quality standards followed
apply appropriate lubricant on the component as per manufacturer's specifications
check and confirm that battery charge, battery water, brake oil, gear oil, engine oil etc. are filled

support the assembly technician in inspecting the final assembly for quality and defects such as loose electrical connections, battery leakage, improper use and placement of electronic components i.e. battery, motor, ECU, sensors & actuators and body surface for paint, dents, grooves, cracks, rough edges, improper part clearances etc.
check the current in battery by using multimeter
store the tools, equipment and fixtures by following organisational policies and procedures after completion of work
dispose scrap or waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
